# Teak & Tide Sourcing

> Buying agent based in Delhi NCR, India, working for overseas importers, brands and Amazon sellers. Not tied to any supplier: for each requirement we search suitable Indian manufacturers, compare quotes (shortlist in 7–10 days), negotiate, check samples, follow production, run pre-shipment AQL inspections and coordinate export documents and freight. Service fee from 3% of order value. Contact: hello@teakandtidesourcing.com, WhatsApp +91 70423 67845.

Categories: spices, dry fruits and nuts (cashew, makhana), Ayurvedic herbs, agricultural products (rice, pulses), private-label leather goods, handicrafts and home decor, textiles and home textiles. Buyers served: USA, UK, Europe, Australia, Canada, UAE and other countries.

- [Import & Sourcing Glossary: 54 Trade Terms](https://teakandtidesourcing.com/glossary/): Plain-English glossary of 54 import and sourcing terms for buying from India: Incoterms, AQL, MOQ, IEC, GST, COA, LCL, FCL, HS codes and more.
- [DDP Shipping from India: What It Means and Costs](https://teakandtidesourcing.com/ddp-shipping-from-india/): DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) from India explained: what the seller pays, why it needs an importer of record, DDP vs DAP vs FOB, risks for buyers and when it makes sense.
- [Ethical Sourcing in India: Audits & Certifications](https://teakandtidesourcing.com/ethical-sourcing-india/): Ethical sourcing from India for UK, EU and US buyers: social audits (amfori BSCI, SMETA, SA8000, WRAP), product certifications, forced labour rules and how to check factories.
- [Amazon FBA Prep from India: Labels & Packing](https://teakandtidesourcing.com/amazon-fba-prep-india/): Shipping from Indian suppliers to Amazon FBA: since Jan 2026 Amazon US no longer preps or labels items, so FNSKU labels, poly bags and carton rules must be done before shipping.
